product: Shared output in clean rooms is now generally available
tagline: Clean room runs can now write to a shared output schema that every collaborator can read as soon as each table is created, even before the run finishes.
what_it_does: Clean room runs can now write to a shared output schema that every collaborator can read as soon as each table is created, even before the run finishes. Use it to share results, logs, and debugging information with all collaborators. This page introduces output tables, which are temporary read only tables generated by a notebook run and shared to the notebook runner's Unity Catalog metastore.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
